text: Thus we see, that while a pressure on A, in the direction AB, produces the strains AF and AG, on the pieces AC and AD, it has excited a strain Cl or DM in the place DC. And this completes the mechanism of a frame; for all derive their efficacy from the triangles of which they are composed, as will ape your more clearly as we proceed.
